questions.question: How did Job respond after God spoke?
options: He repented in dust and ashes
questions.answer: He repented in dust and ashes

questions.question: What did God do for Job in the end?
options: Gave him a brand new name and a place at the royal court
Left him poor but finally at peace with his Maker
Took him quietly away to rest among his ancestors
Restored his fortunes and gave him twice as much as before
questions.answer: Restored his fortunes and gave him twice as much as before
